stem: What happens next in this passage after “Many did so before the water rose.”?
options: Older residents remembered meeting there before mobile phones.
However, some older residents did not use smartphones.
A local group helped older residents learn how to use the cards.
However, students noticed that quieter neighborhoods with older residents had fewer online reports, possibly because people there did not use the website.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many did so before the water rose. However, some older residents did not use smartphones.」，答案為「However, some older residents did not use smartphones.」。
